method: Mobile source-object labels kept only where they fit the Windows link order (alphabetical within the game and engine-library sequences, longest consistent run chain); every other function is placed by the anchors around it. See windows-link-order.md. Functions without such a label are placed by recorded evidence (placements, or an object's own evidence).
